## CookieExpiryInfo interface

Diagnostics explaining how the expiry of a [Cookie](./tough-cookie.cookie.md) was determined.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface CookieExpiryInfo 
```

## Remarks

This is a debugging aid: it captures the raw `Expires`<!-- -->/`Max-Age` attributes as received, what they parsed to, the clock readings used when the cookie was stored (including any server-time correction supplied via [SetCookieOptions.now](./tough-cookie.setcookieoptions.now.md)<!-- -->), which attribute ended up deciding the expiry, and the final expiry time that was derived.

All timestamps are ISO-8601 strings in UTC (`Date.toISOString()`<!-- -->), so the same `Set-Cookie` string produces the same values regardless of the local timezone of the machine that parsed it. The object contains only plain JSON-safe values (strings, numbers, `null`<!-- -->, and arrays thereof) so it can be logged with `JSON.stringify`<!-- -->.

The information is a snapshot of the parse and store operations; later mutations of the cookie (e.g. calling [Cookie.setMaxAge()](./tough-cookie.cookie.setmaxage.md)<!-- -->) are not reflected.

For `Max-Age` cookies this is computed against [CookieExpiryInfo.storedAt](./tough-cookie.cookieexpiryinfo.storedat.md) (or [CookieExpiryInfo.parsedAt](./tough-cookie.cookieexpiryinfo.parsedat.md) if the cookie was never stored). `null` for session cookies and for values outside the representable `Date` range.
